notes: Form 1040 line 25a: 'Add the amounts shown as federal income tax withheld on your Form(s) W-2. The amount withheld should be shown in box 2 of Form W-2' (i1040gi-2025 l.2551-2556). Aggregates the adopted W-2 box-2 family through its own closure, same collect+add+round shape as rule.wages-line1a (box 1). Closed-empty publishes zero only on a current literal-true closure; nonempty present-source paths aggregate without requiring closure, same as box 1 -- a box-1 W-2 recorded without a matching box-2 answer is not separately detected (P0 Sec. 3; Track 1 contract item 2).
